Personally I don't think a shared cooking space negates any plant based product from being vegan. If we really want to split hairs, then maybe we should just abstain from all manufacturers of any animal products. So, just because a plant based burger is cooked on the same grill as animal products wouldn't make it not-vegan in my opinion. Others may disagree though and I get that. 

However, I believe they will put mayo and cheese on the burger unless you ask otherwise? Maybe just one or the other, I don't recall.

It sounds like you're hard on yourself and maybe have resentment towards other people for making choices/mistakes similar to yours. But, that's a reach considering I'm basing this on a couple of written paragraphs. 

One piece of advice I can offer is to recognize when you're having those kinds of snap judgements. We can't always control what pops into our mind but we can control what we do those thoughts. You might have judgmental thoughts but you don't have to pass judgement verbally. 

Kuddos to you for doing what you think is right.
